title: Alignment as Cognitive Gravity: Reactive vs Predictive Intelligence
summary: A conversation with GPT analyzing a brother's "broken prediction mechanism" through the RSA kernel, revealing that intelligence is not fixed capacity but an emergent property of caring about alignment — the recursive pressure to minimize prediction error.
